status: additional analysis: computed from the runs of the main analysis; changes none of its contrasts, margins or thresholds
definitions: stored correct: the store's state for the slot at the probe time (newest served item at B=0) is the gold under scoring.normalize.contract_valid; unverifiable or no value is the state abstain; u = P(ContractValid | stored correct), l = P(ContractValid | stored wrong); r = r_store u + (1 - r_store) l
caveats: the stored value is the item's typed value (eval_value); the reader sees the writer's statement, which may differ (the reader corrects some wrong typed values: l > 0)
u holds retrieval of the statement among all served statements, stale competitors at B=0 and the reader's reading

the source-epoch key counts an item-time as invalidated when it was invalidated at or before the checkpoint, as the paper's m does; about 1% of the changed item-times were not re-derived at their own checkpoint and are counted under r
an unverifiable item is not served and counts as the state abstain
